rgb_note: Ghost-like smudges on some walls come from people walking alongside the scanner; they are baked into the photos.

slam_map.note: Black = walls (occupied over ≥1.2 m of height), gray = furniture and low objects, white = floor seen by the scanner, blue-gray = never observed. Grid 5 cm.

model.method: Screened Poisson surface reconstruction (octree depth 11) of the 2 cm cleaned cloud, trimmed to within 5 cm of real points, decimated to 700,000 triangles and colored from the photo-colored points.
